leads.Personalized Subject Line: What I Thought Joy Was, and a December launch
leads.Personalized Email Body:
Hi Jesse,

My name is Femi Emmanuel. I'm a designer and book services specialist, helping authors professionally present, publish, and promote their books.

I came across What I Thought Love Required and What I Thought Loss Meant while researching your work. I was particularly interested in the inherited rules in the first book (be useful, be agreeable, need less, carry more) and in the second book's idea that loss can arrive as a move or a fading friendship rather than a goodbye.

Those details gave me an idea for how a Christmas preorder campaign could help present your books to more of the readers who may enjoy them. With What I Thought Joy Was due in December, I'm picturing a short holiday preorder push for Book 3 that also invites new readers to start the series with Books 1 and 2, using your existing release-updates list.

I'd be happy to put together a complimentary concept sample so you can see the direction I have in mind.

Would you be open to taking a look?

Warm regards,
Femi Emmanuel
